title: CASE-06 — No delivery proof: acceptance, due date and money all stay empty
note: INPUT ONLY, synthetic (golden rule 11): no real parties, Udyam or GSTIN numbers. No outputs are stored here; every number comes from the engine. Stretch case: it exists to show a first-class blocked state rather than an error - no delivery date means no acceptance, no due date, no interest, a capped readiness score and Stage 1 recommended (architecture.md 6.2 and 7).
why_calculation_date: Deliberate: 2026-07-15 sits inside the configured 5.50% Bank Rate epoch, so the date is priceable in principle and the empty money blocks can only be the missing delivery proof, never a missing rate. Bank Rate epochs before 2026-04-01 are not captured yet (V1 uncaptured, CR-8).
